messages:
incident-bot: PAGER (sev=high) - billing/metering anomaly detected: shadow ledger vs canonical token counts diverging by ~12% over last 30m. Overages being auto-flagged for a small customer subset. Paging oncall @oncall-jamie and SREs. 

oncall-jamie: Ack. I'm on it, paging SRE lead @sre-lee. Starting triage.

sre-lee: Looking at emitter pipeline and shadow aggregator. Quick check: consumer offsets show a replay from emitter pool v3 starting ~02:12Z. Suspect duplicate ack/emit.
sre-lee: tail logs from emitter-3 -> `ERROR duplicate_event id=3a5f... count=2` and intermittent `kafka commit failed, retrying`

billing-ana: We're seeing ~35 accounts with overage flags in the UI (alerts fired). No invoices auto-sent yet. Holding billing pipeline for now.

ml-raj: Model infra note: KV TTL changes last night shouldn't affect counts. This looks like client/emitter duplication or at-least-once replay. I'll monitor embedding/ingest latencies but likely infra.

sre-lee: Short mitigation plan: 1) enable dedupe filter at emitter ingress 2) pause secondary emitter pool to stop in-flight replays 3) run short reconciliation job to snapshot counts T-15m and compare.

oncall-jamie: I'm applying the rate-limit to emitter-3 (cut ~30% traffic) and enabling dedupe filter now. Command: `kubectl patch deployment emitter-3 -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"emitter","env":[{"name":"DEDUP_ENABLED","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'`

sre-lee: Dedupe enabled. Observed duplicate rate drop from ~12% -> 1.1% within 6m.

billing-ana: I toggled auto-flagging suppression for the affected pipeline so customers won't get new overage emails while we reconcile. Will hold any billing actions.

product-zoe: Preliminary customer impact: looks like inflated token counts in dashboards for a small subset; potential incorrect overage flags but no charges applied yet. Recommend proactive comms to top 10 impacted accounts once we confirm reconciliation timeframe.

cs-emma: I'll stand by to send the proactive note. Draft outline: brief incident summary, we're pausing billing, no charges expected, timeline for reconciliation and next update in 2 hours.

finance-jorge: If any charges slipped through before suppression, we'll credit. Please tag finance before invoices are finalized.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - dedupe filter pushed and rate limit applied. Duplicate emission rate down to ~0.8% in the last 12m. Triage moving to recon/backfill.

sre-lee: Starting backfill/reconciliation job job-id `recon-20260317-001` to realign shadow ledger with canonical. Estimated runtime ~45m (depends on window size). Kicking off now. Logs will flow to https://internal.redwood/ops/recon-20260317-001

billing-ana: Once recon completes we'll snapshot before/after counts and run a diff to update flags. Keeping suppressed flags until diff validated.

oncall-jamie: Handoff note: paging downgraded to monitoring; SREs will complete backfill. If duplicate rate creeps >2% or new overage flags appear, please repage.

product-zoe: Agreed. Product will prepare comms; CS will coordinate with finance for any credits.

cs-emma: Draft ready, will hold send until we have recon ETA confirmation.

incident-bot: RESOLUTION: dedupe + rate-limiting mitigated active duplication. Backfill started. Pager status set to resolved (no active paging). Postmortem required: owners eng/sre + billing + product.

sre-lee: Backfill progress: ~20% done at 12m, estimated 36m remaining. We'll post final reconciliation diff when complete. :thumbsup:

oncall-jamie: Thanks team. Closing live mitigation channel; will create incident ticket and link postmortem.
